page.layout: One column of text, with a centred block of Arabic verse in the middle and an italic Latin translation below it. No marginal notes. Printed page number at the head.

main_text.p: Armenorum, sub die 30. Septembris; eodem S. Philippus Diaconus, sub die 11. Octobris; sanctus Nicander Episcopus Myræ, sub die 4. Novembris; sanctus Paulus Archiepiscopus Constantinopolitanus, sub die 6. eiusdem mensis; sanctus Theodorus Abbas, sub die 11. eiusdem; Sanctus Ioannes Damascenus, sub die 4. Decembris; Sanctus Maximus, sub die 21. Ianuarij. Eodem ferme omnes sancti Patres Ecclesiæ Doctores.
Eosdem etiam Patres esse Fidei Canonem, idem testatur Menologium. Sic enim sub die decima octava Februarij legimus de sancto Leone Papa:

[illegible, ~6 letters] اطْهِرتـك افعـال الـــــق لرعيتـــــــك قانونـــا للامانه وصورة للوداعـــه ومعلمـــا للمساك ايها الاب لاون لاجل هـــذا اقتنيت بالتواضع الرفعـــه وبالمسكنـــه الغنـــا فتشفـــع الى المسيح الالـــه أن يغلـــص من نفوسـ ـــــــــــ [?]

p.i: Profecto te promulgarunt opera veritatis gregi tuo CANONEM ad fidem, & exemplar ad manfuetudinem, atque Doctorem continentiæ, O Pater Leo; quapropter comparasti humi-lita-

page.notes: The Arabic block is only partly legible at this scan resolution. The first line is illegible. The remaining lines are my best reading and are not verified letter by letter, so the whole block should be checked against the original. The Latin translation is clear. Italic in the translation is shown as printed. The printed "Nouembris" and "Eofdem" were changed to "Novembris" and "Eosdem" under the u/v rule. "octaua" was changed to "octava" under the same rule. The Latin text continues on the next page, with "tem" completing "humilitatem".
